title: Exam and study check-in
description: For exam weeks: what's coming up, a simple study plan, and where to get help.

steps.text: Do you have any exams or big assignments coming up?
acks: Okay, thanks. Let's think about a plan.

steps.text: On a scale of one to five, how prepared do you feel?

low.text: That's okay, there's still time to make progress. Here's a simple plan that works for a lot of students.

First, list the topics the exam covers. Second, start with the ones you feel least sure about, in short blocks of about twenty-five minutes. Third, test yourself with practice problems instead of just rereading.

low.reason: Exam stress: student feels underprepared (low priority follow-up).

mid.text: Sounds like you're on your way. Practice problems and explaining ideas out loud are great ways to find gaps.

high.text: That's great. Remember to get some sleep the night before, it really helps memory.

steps.text: Would you like me to share where you can get study help?

no.text: Okay! Good luck, you've got this.
